kind: exploratory ablation, one task per variant

reviewFindings: parse.mjs: ID_PATTERN uses $, which permits a match before a final line terminator. An id such as "abc\n" is accepted, violating the requirement that ids contain only 1–32 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. Require the match to consume the entire id.

reviewFindings: parse.mjs: ID_RE uses $, which permits a match before a final line terminator. IDs such as "abc\n" or "abc\r" are therefore accepted, violating the requirement that every ID character be an ASCII letter, digit, underscore, or hyphen. These records must produce SCHEMA errors.

postHocAdjudication.notes: Root independently ran post-hoc diagnostics. No code repair. Initial review verdict preserved; adjudication model overhead unmeasured.

reviewFindings: parse.mjs: ID_RE uses $, which can match before a final newline. An id such as "a\n" passes validation, violating the ASCII letters/digits/_/- only requirement.

cli.mjs: tempPath is assigned before exclusive open succeeds. If open fails because that path already exists, cleanup unlinks the unowned file, violating temporary-file ownership and unrelated-file preservation requirements.

cli.mjs: short(err) prints truncated raw exception messages, which can include user-supplied paths containing credentials or sensitive input. Use sanitized failure messages to satisfy the stderr privacy requirement.

postHocAdjudication.notes: Root independently ran post-hoc diagnostics. No code repair. Initial review verdict preserved; adjudication model overhead unmeasured.
